sourceReview: Source/map, original cwd and registry row are rechecked; user/profile scope comes from the complete active User layer. Inherited-only, duplicate contributing layers, malformed transport and policy refusal do not gain write authority.

One quoted keyPath segment modifies enabled only. Full selected-layer semantic JSON plus all other captured layers are compared, including private transport credentials, unknown fields and arrays. Public DTOs contain only safe name/transport/booleans and fixed codes; private values are not projected.

List-to-get subset acceptance is limited to original known fields; confirm retains complete Report equality and final observe now retains complete target equality. Configured preference and official get report remain separate facts.

Shared P40/P41 registry gates kind for duplicate requests/status/cancel/confirm/recheck. A wrongly addressed MCP operation cannot borrow skills authority. Final read-only recheck retains original dispatch/ack and reports Observed, not historical write success.

The synthetic post-get cancellation test holds the actual second owned child and shared activity/global worker lease. Cancellation is not settlement; unknown write state remains until real child cleanup. Recheck performs no additional write.

Narrow frontend inspection confirms Flight.port remains captured by original kind, original InventoryResult.request is used for management, and markStale only retires that exact request. No frontend test or browser suite was independently repeated.
limits: 35 tests include existing P40 coverage and author tests; they are not 35 independent P41 cases. The earlier 32-test run began compiling while the second independent test was added; no source-stability claim is attached to that run.

The 19 source hashes are verified at this review time. The author checkpoint is after the associated run; this review does not manufacture a missing pre-run hash checkpoint or substitute for root full engineering.
